# Caraka Saṃhitā

-> Buffalo Meat Juice <-

Clean, sweet, and sprouted black gram <term>māṣa</term> <gloss>Vigna mungo</gloss> along with water chestnuts <term>jaḍāphala</term> <gloss>Trapa natans</gloss> should be added to buffalo meat juice. This juice should be prepared with a generous amount of clarified butter <term>ghṛta</term>, curd, and pomegranate. When seasoned with the proper amount of coriander, cumin, and dry ginger, this juice, when consumed as a drink or with food, makes the semen inexhaustible. 8.

> Thus ends the recipe for aphrodisiac buffalo meat juice.

One who eats fresh fish or small glistening fish <term>śapharī</term> <gloss>a species of small carp, Puntius sophore</gloss> fried in hot clarified butter does not experience depletion of vigor during sexual union with women. 9.

> Thus ends the recipe for fish fried in clarified butter as an aphrodisiac.

One desiring progeny should use <term>rohita</term> fish <gloss>Labeo rohita, the red-scaled carp</gloss> fried in clarified butter and cooked in goat meat juice prepared with acidic fruits. After eating the fish, the remaining juice should also be consumed. 10.

> Thus ends the formulation for promoting conception.

Take finely minced fish meat and mix it with asafoetida <term>hiṅgu</term>, rock salt <term>saindhava</term>, and coriander. Combine this with wheat flour and cook as small cakes <term>pūpalikā</term> <gloss>pancakes or fried dough</gloss> in clarified butter. 

Alternatively, cook fish in buffalo meat juice along with unctuous, sour, and salty ingredients. When the juice has been fully absorbed into the meat, crush the fish and add black pepper, cumin, coriander, a little asafoetida, and fresh clarified butter. This preparation should be used as a filling for cakes made of black gram flour. 

These two formulations for cakes are aphrodisiac, increase physical strength, provide sexual excitement and good fortune, are nourishing, and are superior for the increase of semen. 11.

> Thus ends the two aphrodisiac cake formulations.

---
The flour of black gram <term>māṣa</term>, cowhage <term>ātmaguptā</term> <gloss>Mucuna pruriens</gloss>, wheat, <term>śāli</term> rice, and <term>ṣaṣṭika</term> rice <note>a variety of rice that matures in sixty days</note>...

<summary>This page details various Ayurvedic aphrodisiac recipes involving meat juices, fried fish, and stuffed cakes. These formulations are intended to increase semen, physical strength, and fertility.</summary>
